name: 伊贝儿
evolution: 伊贝儿 → 伊贝粉粉 Lv.28
description: 它头顶长着一团蓬松的绿色苔藓，压低身体时能很好地融入草丛，几乎难以分辨。苔藓本身不疏水，一旦沾到水就会迅速吸收并变得沉重，让它行动迟缓甚至走不动，只能停在原地等待自然风干。它的身体像果冻一样具有弹性，可拉伸变形。
descriptionEn: A tuft of fluffy green moss grows on its head; when it lowers its body it blends into the grass so well that it is almost impossible to tell apart. The moss itself is not water-repellent, so once it gets wet it quickly absorbs water and becomes heavy, making it sluggish or even unable to walk, so it can only stay where it is and wait to dry naturally. Its body is elastic like jelly and can be stretched and deformed.
